panels.prompt: A rain-slick studio backlot glows under red, green, and blue cinema light.
A young filmmaker walks toward a luminous stage door, hesitant but drawn in.
A hand reaches for a brass door handle, rain drops visible in shallow focus.
Eyes reflect the world beyond the door; fear turns into awe.
The door opens to a vast cinematic desert set inside the studio.
The camera moves through the doorway into a story world of dust and moonlight.
The filmmaker smiles with tears as the script becomes a living movie.
